title: SOC2 evidence + vendor review - daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence / vendor reviews / quick TODOs

2024-11-28 (notes while triaging evidence requests)
- Quick status: prepping evidence for CC3 (change management) and CC7 (backup & recovery). CC3 missing patch window screenshots for 10/2024 - ask infra.
- Vendor reviews: finish QuickScan for Auth0 replacement (AuthN vendor) and start checklist for new logging vendor (LogWave?).
- Reminder: generate consolidated export of access logs (prod) for scope window 2024-09-01 -> 2024-11-01. Partial export in s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/logs-export-20241127.csv - needs full run (run next overnight job).

TODO (priority ordering)
1) Evidence collection: CC3 patch management screenshots (10/2024) - owner: Liam Nguyen - target: 2024-11-30 - Linked JIRA: JIRA-SEC-112.
2) Evidence collection: CC7 backup test report for DB cluster - owner: Evelyn Chen - target: 2024-12-05 - ask infra for restore logs and run a table-level restore test.
3) Vendor review: complete questionnaire for LogWave draft (privacy, data residency, breach notification SLA) - I will draft answers and send to vendor by 2024-11-29.
4) Policy TODO: update retention policy doc to reflect 90d logs retention on ephemeral nodes (draft in Confluence) - assign to Priya for review.
5) Evidence packaging: zip + manifest for external auditor - manifest template in CONFLUENCE-SEC-2543.

Open questions / notes to self
- Does dedicated VPC pipeline for Private deployments have separate backup policy? Need to confirm if Private backups are excluded from scope or require separate evidence. ping @infra on Slack.
- LogWave eval: confirm whether they support customer-owned KMS (important for private deployments). If not, escalate to procurement.
- For vendor contracts: do we require SOC2 Type II from vendors with access to customer data, or is a well-scoped security questionnaire acceptable? Draft guidance needed.

Quick actions (today)
- 10:00am: sync with Liam (15m) - ask for patch management screenshots + dates (remote screenshot preferred).
- 11:30am: run full access log export job (script: infra/tools/export_logs.sh) -> outputs to s3 path above. If fails, escalate to SRE on-call.
- 3:00pm: draft answers to LogWave questionnaire (start from previous vendor template in Confluence).

Evidence checklist (working)
- [ ] CC3: patch windows (screenshots + ticket links)
- [x] CC2: user access revocation policy (policy doc draft exists)
- [ ] CC7: backup & restore logs + test results
- [ ] Vendor: data processing addendum (DPA) for LogWave
- [ ] Auditor package: manifest + readme + contact points

Short snippets / shorthand (for later copy-paste)
- "Patch management evidence: screenshot of patch console (with host filter + timestamp), associated ticket ID, and deployment run output (stdout)."
- "Backup restore test: table-level restore of users table to staging, verify row counts and integrity, attach query used and timestamps."

Links / refs (quick)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Catalog
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-SEC-112
- Slack: #security-compliance (pin thread: vendor-contracts-2024)

Notes for auditor packaging (short)
- Keep file names short, include manifest.csv with columns: file_name, description, owner, date_collected, jira_ref.
- Encrypt zip with customer key; upload to s3://redwood-compliance/audit-packages/2024-11/ and share pre-signed link (expires in 72h).

Random brain dump (incomplete thoughts)
- Could we automate snapshot evidence collection for patch mgmt next quarter? Explore a lambda that pulls the dashboard and stores screenshots daily.
- Consider adding a vendor risk column to the central vendor spreadsheet: privacy-impact-level (low/med/high) + KMS support + DPA status.

--
Rachel
